PARA.TITLE: Multi-information Display Radar Cruise Display Mode

ITEM.PTXT: The set vehicle speed, control status, etc. of the radar cruise control are displayed as text information, and the presence of a preceding vehicle, set following distance and brake control information are displayed with symbol marks on the display.
